name: detect-secrets
description: Detects hardcoded secrets, credentials, and sensitive tokens committed to source code

steps: collect_files: git diff or path argument; skip binaries, lock files, .gitignore
match_lines: regex match each line against all rules
capture: file, line, rule_id, severity, masked snippet
render: report with summary table and immediate actions

rules.name: AWS Access Key
rules.remediation: Revoke in AWS IAM. Store in Secrets Manager.

rules.name: GCP Service Account Key
rules.remediation: Delete in GCP IAM. Use Workload Identity Federation.

rules.name: Azure Client Secret
rules.remediation: Rotate in Azure AD. Use Key Vault.

rules.name: Private Key Material
rules.remediation: Revoke and regenerate. Use secrets manager.

rules.name: Stripe Secret Key
rules.remediation: Roll key in Stripe Dashboard. Use environment variables.

rules.name: Slack Token
rules.remediation: Revoke in Slack app management console.

rules.name: Generic API Key Assignment
rules.remediation: Move to environment variables or secrets manager.

rules.name: Database Password Assignment
rules.remediation: Use connection string from environment. Never hardcode passwords.

rules.name: JWT Secret
rules.remediation: Use long random secret from environment variable.

rules.name: npm Registry Token
rules.remediation: Use npm login with CI secrets store.

rules.name: Docker Registry Credential
rules.remediation: Use docker credential helpers or CI secrets.

rules.name: SSH Private Key
rules.remediation: Remove from repo immediately. Rotate key pair.

rules.name: Hardcoded Connection String
rules.remediation: Use environment variable for full connection string.

rules.name: SendGrid API Key
rules.remediation: Revoke in SendGrid dashboard. Use environment variables.
